A step-down transformer is 100% efficient. It has an input voltage of 240V a.c. and an output
voltage of 60V a.c.
The current in the primary coil is 0.50A.
What is the current in the secondary coil?
A
0.13A
B
0.50A
C
2.0A
D
8.0A
subject: Physics
